cases.title: Discard password when Never For This Site is selected
cases.description: Select Never For This Site in the save password dialog box and verify that the browser discards the password.

cases.title: Available presentation of multiple saved choices
cases.description: Verify that when multiple usernames and passwords for a website are saved, those same choices are later available to be presented.

cases.title: Password Manager updates changed password
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password for a website are saved and later the password is changed, the password manager picks up the new password.

cases.title: Disable Password Manager Stops Save Prompts and Prefill
cases.description: Verify that when the password manager is disabled from the preferences panel, the browser no longer asks to save passwords and no longer gets prefilled info on sites.

cases.title: View saved username and password in password manager preferences
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password in the password manager are saved, this information can be viewed in the password manager through preferences.

cases.title: Remove credential stops autofill and removes from manager
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password for a given site are removed, they no longer autofill on that site and are no longer listed in the password manager.

cases.title: Remove all username and password information
cases.description: Verify that removing all username and password information results in no autofill on sites and nothing being listed in the password manager.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and test cases have been evaluated. The test cases cover every requirement accurately without any blockers, coverage gaps, or redundancies.

analysis.analysis: Requirement R-102: Multiple distinct behaviors; trigger is selecting Never For This Site in the save password dialog box, expected outcome is discarding the password. Requirement R-103: Multiple distinct behaviors; trigger is saving multiple usernames and passwords, expected outcome is those choices being available later to be presented. Requirement R-104: Multiple distinct behaviors; trigger is changing the password after saving, expected outcome is the password manager picking up the new password. Requirement R-105: Multiple distinct behaviors; triggers are disabling the password manager from preferences, expected outcomes are no longer asking to save passwords and no longer getting prefilled info. Requirement R-106: Single straightforward acceptance criterion; Normal test scenario warranted for viewing saved credentials in preferences. Requirement R-107: Multiple distinct behaviors; triggers are removing a credential for a site, expected outcomes are no longer autofilling and no longer being listed in the password manager. Requirement R-108: Multiple distinct behaviors; triggers are removing all credential information, expected outcomes are no longer autofilling and nothing being listed in the password manager.
